name: tononkira
description: Tononkira — paroles de chansons malagasy : collecte (data), API (api) et interface web (web).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test -w web && npm run data:test
